This is calculating the number of elevated genes in the region of the forebrain. All data is pulled from [here](https://www.proteinatlas.org/humanproteome/brain)

Human:
```{r}
sum(180,83,57,110)
```

Pig:
```{r}
sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
```


Mouse:
```{r}
sum(55,185, 60, 98)
```
